answer: Pay newcomers on a ramp. A fresh identity earns only a kernel rate, 5% of a full share, and climbs 5 points per consecutive passing epoch, reaching full pay after 19 straight passes; one failed or skipped epoch drops it back to the bottom. The ramp is a toll bridge every sock puppet must cross alone: each fake needs ~5 days of distinct, jury-approved answers, so a 1,000-account farm burns 19,000 graded answers of inference before earning near full, and one slip in its shared pigment of style resets that account.
